data.name: Yagana
data.long_meaning: A female name derived from the Arabic word 'yagani' meaning 'to be joyful, delighted or pleased'. It is derived from the root 'w-g-n' which conveys the meaning of 'to rejoice' or 'to find joy'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to bring happiness and joy to those around them.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is believed to have the ability to bring joy and happiness to those around them, spreading positivity and love.

in_arabic.name: يگانة
in_arabic.meaning: يگانة تعني الوحيد أو الفريد من نوعه
in_arabic.long_meaning: يُشتق اسم يگانة من الجذر العربي 'ي-غ-ن' الذي يحمل معاني الوحدة والفرادَة. في اللغة العربية، يعني يگانة الشخص الذي لا مثيل له، الفريد في نوعه. وقد وردت هذه المعاني في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن وحدانية الله تعالى. يعتبر اسم يگانة ذا أهمية روحية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يعكس صفات الله عز وجل كونه وحيدًا وفريدًا في وجوده وصفاته.

in_urdu.name: یگانہ
in_urdu.meaning: یگانہ کا مطلب ہوتا ہے منفرد یا واحد
in_urdu.long_meaning: یگانہ نام عربی جڑ 'ي-غ-ن' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے واحد یا منفرد۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے نوع میں منفرد ہو۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ تعالی کی وحدانیت اور تفرد کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، جیسا کہ قرآن مجید میں مذکور ہے۔

in_hindi.name: यगाना
in_hindi.meaning: यगाना का अर्थ है अद्वितीय या अनोखा
in_hindi.long_meaning: यगाना नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'ي-غ-ن' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है अद्वितीय या अनोखा। देवanagari लिपि में, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है, जहां यह नाम अल्लाह की अद्वितीयता और विशिष्टता को दर्शाता है। यह नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है और अक्सर उन बच्चों को दिया जाता है जो अपने माता-पिता के लिए अनोखे और विशेष होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: يګانه
in_pashto.meaning: يګانه د يو ځانګړي يا بې ساري مطلب دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د يګانه نوم etymology د عربي ريښو 'ي-غ-ن' څخه اخستل شوی دی، چې د واحد يا بې ساري معنی لري. په پښتو کلتور کې، دا نوم د افغانستان او پښتونستان په دوديزو کړو کې کارول کېږي. دا نوم د الهي وحدانیت او بې ساريت په معنا دی، کوم چې د اسلامي عقيدې يو مهم اړخ دی.

in_english.name: Yagana
in_english.meaning: Yagana means unique, singular, or one of a kind
in_english.long_meaning: The name Yagana originates from the Arabic root 'ي-غ-ن' (y-gh-n), which conveys the meanings of uniqueness, singularity, or being one of a kind. In Islamic tradition, this name holds spiritual significance as it reflects the attributes of Allah, emphasizing His oneness and uniqueness, as mentioned in the Quran. Historically, the name Yagana has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person who is considered exceptional or unparalleled. The name carries a sense of distinction and is often chosen for its profound religious and cultural connotations.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yagana carries the tradition and heritage of Islamic naming practices. Islamic names are deeply rooted in the religion, drawing inspiration from the Quran, Hadith or the lives of Prophets or companions. Muhammad, for instance, is the most common name for boys in the Islamic world, as it is the name of the last and final Prophet of Islam. Yagana, being an Arabic name, also connects the girl to her roots and heritage as a Muslim. It is also a way of passing on cultural values and practices, such as giving meaning to names, to future generations.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Yagana lies in the deeper meaning behind the name. The name Yagana is derived from the root 'w-g-n' which convey the meaning of 'to rejoice' or 'to find joy'. Joy and happiness are considered fundamental aspects of Islam. The Quran tells us that Allah loves those who believe and show joy in their faith (Al-Mujadilah 58:22). In Sufism, the path of spiritual development, known as the Tariqah, emphasizes the importance of joy as a means to attain closeness to Allah. Yagana is a reminder of the joy and happiness that can be found in one's faith and connection to Allah. As such, the name Yagana can serve as a constant reminder of the importance of joy and happiness and the connection to Allah for the girl.
